utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good morning, everybody. Mr. Milovancevic, I hope Mr. Martic is well recovered. I see him, he is in court, and can you pass to him the Chamber's good wishes and congratulations on recovery. I guess we are about to call the next witness, Mr. Whiting?

utterances.speaker: MR. WHITING
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. The next witness will be handled by Ms. Richterova. It's a witness who will testify in closed session.

utterances.speaker: MS. RICHTEROVA
utterances.text: The witness MM-016 is ready; the Prosecution would like to call him.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Ms. Richterova. Before he comes in, can we please move into private session?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 23rd day of May, 2006, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.47 p.m.,
